findings.title: OpenTelemetry version coordination
findings.detail: Loose version coupling between OTel packages. Current: @api^1.7.0, @sdk-node^0.47.0, @auto-inst^0.40.0, @exporter^0.47.0. Ensure synchronized upgrades.
findings.recommendation: Lock OTel packages together during upgrades; verify tracing is functional if versions diverge

findings.title: Large transitive dependency tree (577)
findings.detail: Supply chain risk surface. Driven by OTel instrumentation (~50), testing tools (~100), build tools (~50). Normal for modern Node.js. Monitor for deprecated transitive packages.
findings.recommendation: No action required. Run quarterly: npm list --depth=10 | grep DEPRECATED

findings.title: React version split (18.2.0 vs 18.3.1)
findings.detail: Source/Frontend uses react@18.3.1, portal/Frontend uses react@18.2.0. Both are secure and compatible, but version consistency may be desired.
findings.recommendation: Optional: align to 18.3.1+ in next release for consistency

actionable_items: Enable quarterly npm audit in CI/CD
Optional: align React versions for consistency
summary.critical_next_steps: No critical vulnerabilities. Routine maintenance: run npm update before each release.

to_DevOps: Set up quarterly npm audit CI/CD job
Monitor OTel package versions before next release
